reason: GitHub Ubuntu CI failed three tests because re-encoding the same clean PNG did not yield identical compression bytes. Metadata checks must inspect PNG chunks and decoded image, not encoder byte identity.
implementation: Separate RGB PNG archive checker accepts only CRC-checked IHDR/IDAT/IEND with dimensions <=1600. Pinned image SHA remains mandatory; EXIF/text/profiles/animation/trailing data are rejected.
historical_photo_probe_plan: Old execution plans remain immutable and fail closed on source mismatch; no old plan is re-executed.
